title: 6h: orcarouter FP8 uncensored -> Unsloth UD-IQ4_XS with agentic-coding calib
agent_rules: Never start from BF16 or MLX-4bit.
Never skip --parse-special on a live imatrix.
If hours left < 3 after convert, use AtomicChat imatrix and quantize.
If FP8 download not done by t+2h, abort.

steps.cmd: git clone https://github.com/groxaxo/qwen38-flash-next-sharp-chat-template work-playbook && cp work-playbook/quantize_orcarouter_fp8.sh work-playbook/extract_gguf_tensor_map.py work-playbook/build_agentic_coding_calib.py work-playbook/chat_template.jinja . && chmod +x quantize_orcarouter_fp8.sh extract_gguf_tensor_map.py build_agentic_coding_calib.py

git clone https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp llama.cpp && cmake -S llama.cpp -B llama.cpp/build -DGGML_CUDA=ON -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build llama.cpp/build -j --target llama-quantize llama-imatrix llama-gguf-split llama-cli llama-server gguf-new-metadata
python3 -m pip install -U 'huggingface_hub[hf_transfer]' hf_transfer datasets sentencepiece transformers torch gguf numpy
hf download AtomicChat/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF imatrix.gguf --local-dir . && cp -n imatrix.gguf atomic.imatrix.gguf || true

mkdir -p out && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2 CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True,max_split_size_mb:512 python3 ./llama.cpp/convert_hf_to_gguf.py ./hf-src-fp8 --outfile ./out/Qwen38FN-Unc-FP8-unsloth-UD-IQ4_XS.master.q8_0.gguf --outtype q8_0 --fp8-as-q8

if test -s ./out/Qwen38FN-Unc-FP8-unsloth-UD-IQ4_XS.imatrix.gguf; then true; elif test -s ./out/Qwen38FN-Unc-FP8-unsloth-UD-IQ4_XS.agentic.imatrix.gguf; then cp ./out/Qwen38FN-Unc-FP8-unsloth-UD-IQ4_XS.agentic.imatrix.gguf ./out/Qwen38FN-Unc-FP8-unsloth-UD-IQ4_XS.imatrix.gguf; else cp ./atomic.imatrix.gguf ./out/Qwen38FN-Unc-FP8-unsloth-UD-IQ4_XS.imatrix.gguf; fi

SKIP_CONVERT=1 SRC=./out/Qwen38FN-Unc-FP8-unsloth-UD-IQ4_XS.master.q8_0.gguf RECIPE=unsloth QUANT=UD-IQ4_XS MAP=./maps/UD-IQ4_XS.tensor-types IMATRIX=./out/Qwen38FN-Unc-FP8-unsloth-UD-IQ4_XS.imatrix.gguf RECOMPUTE_IMATRIX=0 LLAMA_CPP=./llama.cpp OUT=./out/Qwen38FN-Unc-FP8-unsloth-UD-IQ4_XS ./quantize_orcarouter_fp8.sh

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2 ./llama.cpp/build/bin/llama-cli -m ./out/Qwen38FN-Unc-FP8-unsloth-UD-IQ4_XS-00001-of-*.gguf --jinja --chat-template-file ./chat_template.jinja --reasoning-format deepseek -ngl 99 -sm layer -ts 1,1,1 --override-tensor per_layer_token_embd=CPU -fit off -c 4096 -n 64 -p 'Reply with the single word: pong' --temp 0

serve_after: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2 ./llama.cpp/build/bin/llama-server -m ./out/Qwen38FN-Unc-FP8-unsloth-UD-IQ4_XS-00001-of-*.gguf --mmproj mmproj-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Uncensored-F16.gguf --jinja --chat-template-file ./chat_template.jinja --reasoning-format deepseek -ngl 99 -sm layer -ts 1,1,1 --override-tensor per_layer_token_embd=CPU -fit off -c 32768 --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080 --flash-attn on -t 12 -tb 20
